The function requires year and position. We need to call it twice for president: year 1980, position 'president'; year 2016, position 'president'. And twice for vice president: year 1975, position 'vice president'; year 2011, position 'vice president'.

We should call the function for each query. The function returns any. We need to output the results. The user didn't specify format, but likely a simple answer: 1980 president was Jimmy Carter? Wait, 1980: Carter was president until Jan 20, 1981. So 1980 president: Jimmy Carter. 2016 president: Barack Obama until Jan 20, 2017. So 2016 president: Barack Obama. Vice president 1975: Gerald Ford was VP from 1973 to 1974, then after Ford became president, Vice President was Nelson Rockefeller? Wait, timeline: Gerald Ford became president on August 9, 1974 after Nixon's resignation. He had no vice president until his term ended in January 1977. So 1975 vice president: None (there was no vice president). Actually, the position was vacant. So answer: None. Vice president 2011: Joe Biden was VP under Obama from 2009 to 2017. So 2011 vice president: Joe Biden.
